api_error_after_max_retries.description: Claude API failed after 5 retry attempts
api_error_after_max_retries.action: Pause automation, save checkpoint, ask user to check API status or retry later

working_more_than_4_hours.description: Automation has been running for more than 4 hours continuously
working_more_than_4_hours.action: Ask user if they want to continue or take a break, save checkpoint

unclear_requirements.description: Business requirements are ambiguous or missing critical information
unclear_requirements.action: Ask specific questions to clarify requirements before proceeding

multiple_valid_stack_options.description: Multiple tech stacks are equally suitable based on requirements
multiple_valid_stack_options.action: Present options with pros/cons, ask user to choose
multiple_valid_stack_options.example: Both serverless and Lightsail fit the requirements. Serverless offers better scaling but Lightsail is simpler and cheaper for predictable traffic.

critical_security_decision.description: Security-related decision that requires user input
critical_security_decision.action: Explain security implications, ask for user decision

deployment_credentials_needed.description: Deployment requires credentials or API keys
deployment_credentials_needed.action: Ask user to provide credentials via secure method

dependency_conflict.action: Ask user to choose dependency version or resolution strategy

database_migration_risk.description: Database migration may result in data loss
database_migration_risk.action: Show migration plan, ask for confirmation before proceeding

budget_exceeded.description: Estimated infrastructure cost exceeds stated budget
budget_exceeded.action: Show cost breakdown, ask user to adjust requirements or approve higher cost

breaking_change_detected.description: Proposed change would break existing functionality
breaking_change_detected.action: Explain impact, ask for confirmation or alternative approach

minor_code_style_issue.description: Code style doesn't match standards but is functionally correct

outdated_dependency_patch.description: Patch version update available for dependency

missing_test_file.description: Test file doesn't exist for new code
missing_test_file.action: Generate test file with basic test cases

requirements_file_missing.action: Abort with error message, ask user to provide requirements file

unsupported_stack_requested.description: User requested a tech stack not in available templates
unsupported_stack_requested.action: List available stacks, ask user to choose or request custom stack creation

git_repo_not_initialized.description: Git repository not initialized but git operations are enabled
git_repo_not_initialized.action: Ask user if they want to initialize git repo or disable git operations

insufficient_permissions.description: Automation lacks permissions to create/modify files
insufficient_permissions.action: Report permission issue, ask user to fix permissions

file_lock.description: File is locked by another process
